title: The first digest
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Friday. Five strips, one staple. The rack at the laundromat. Distribution.

panels.composition: The laundromat. WOOD at the folding table with a stapler and five strips. The OWNER watching from the dryers.
props: the free rack by the door

balloons.text: This week. Five days. One digest.

image.prompt: a young man stapling five photocopied comic strips into a booklet at a laundromat folding table while an older man folds towels by the dryers

panels.composition: The digest. A cover drawn on the spot: the laundromat itself, the rack, this exact moment.

image.prompt: close-up of a small stapled zine whose cover is a brush-pen drawing of the very laundromat it sits in
image.notes: The first digest cover. The cover is a drawing of where it's being read.

panels.composition: Wood setting the digest in the free rack, between a real-estate flyer and a church bulletin.

characters.pose: placing the digest in the rack

balloons.text: Between property and God. Where the reader lives.

image.prompt: a young man placing a small stapled zine into a free-paper rack between a real estate flyer and a church bulletin by a laundromat door

panels.composition: The laundromat from the door. The rack. The digest in it. A woman with a basket reaching for the real-estate flyer. Not the digest. Not yet.
props: a woman with a laundry basket

image.prompt: a laundromat seen from its door, a free rack with a small zine in it, a woman with a laundry basket reaching past it for a flyer, a young man watching from the doorway, black and white

art.line: brush-pen now — the weekday deadline teaches the hand to commit; still xeroxed, still black and white
art.paper: the college paper's newsprint; the digest's quarter-letter xerox

notes: The laundromat digest begins. The cover drawn on the spot is the proto-Sunday.
